sets.title: Grow the Bird Sentence
sets.titleEs: Haz crecer la oración del pájaro

learn.rule: Add who, what, where, when, or why to grow a sentence.
learn.ruleEs: Agrega quién, qué, dónde, cuándo o por qué para hacer crecer la oración.
learn.model: 🐦 The red bird sings in the tree every morning.
learn.notice: Find the words for who, where, and when.

items.why: Every morning tells when the bird sings.
items.whyEs: Every morning dice cuándo canta el pájaro.

items.prompt: Which question does 'in the tall tree' answer?
items.text: 🐦 The bird sings in the tall tree.
items.why: In the tall tree tells where the bird sings.
items.whyEs: In the tall tree dice dónde canta el pájaro.

items.prompt: Which question does 'to call its family' answer?
items.text: 🐦 The bird sings to call its family.
items.why: To call its family tells why the bird sings.
items.whyEs: To call its family dice por qué canta el pájaro.

items.model: 🐿️ The squirrel hides nuts under the old log.
items.why: Under the old log tells where the squirrel hides nuts.
items.whyEs: Under the old log dice dónde esconde nueces la ardilla.

items.prompt: Check every group of words that adds when.
items.why: After the rain, at sunrise, and each spring tell when.
items.whyEs: After the rain, at sunrise y each spring dicen cuándo.

items.prompt: Which owl sentence is the strongest?

options.text: 🦉 The owl hunts mice in the dark forest at night.

items.why: The last sentence adds what, where, and when.
items.whyEs: La última oración agrega qué, dónde y cuándo.

write.prompt: Say the short sentence. Then say it again and add where and when.
write.promptEs: Di la oración corta. Luego dila otra vez agregando dónde y cuándo.

label: It sounds like a whole sentence
Suena como una oración completa

write.model: A small fish swims in the pond every day.

familyTalk.en: Pick a short sentence like 'The dog runs.' and grow it together with where and when.
familyTalk.es: Elijan una oración corta como 'The dog runs.' y háganla crecer juntos con dónde y cuándo.

teacherTip.en: Use question cards (Who? Where? When?). Draw a card and have children add that detail aloud.
teacherTip.es: Usa tarjetas de preguntas (Who? Where? When?). Saca una tarjeta y pide que agreguen ese detalle en voz alta.

sets.title: Grow a Town Sentence
sets.titleEs: Haz crecer una oración del pueblo

learn.rule: Add who, what, where, when, or why to grow a sentence.
learn.ruleEs: Agrega quién, qué, dónde, cuándo o por qué para hacer crecer la oración.
learn.model: 🚶 The mail carrier walks down our street every afternoon.

items.prompt: Which question does 'on Main Street' answer?
items.text: 🏪 The shop opens on Main Street.
items.why: On Main Street tells where the shop opens.
items.whyEs: On Main Street dice dónde abre la tienda.

items.prompt: Which question does 'at eight o'clock' answer?
items.text: 🏪 The shop opens at eight o'clock.
items.why: At eight o'clock tells when the shop opens.
items.whyEs: At eight o'clock dice cuándo abre la tienda.

items.prompt: Which question does 'to help sick people' answer?
items.text: 🏥 The doctor works to help sick people.
items.why: To help sick people tells why the doctor works.
items.whyEs: To help sick people dice por qué trabaja el doctor.

items.model: 🚒 The brave firefighters rush to the fire.
items.why: The brave firefighters tells who rushes to the fire.
items.whyEs: The brave firefighters dice quién corre al incendio.

items.prompt: Check every group of words that adds where.
items.why: At the library, near the park, and across the river tell where.
items.whyEs: At the library, near the park y across the river dicen dónde.

items.prompt: Which baker sentence tells the most?

options.text: 🥖 The baker bakes bread in the shop at dawn.

items.why: The last sentence adds what, where, and when.
items.whyEs: La última oración agrega qué, dónde y cuándo.

write.prompt: Say the short sentence. Then say it again and add where and when.
write.promptEs: Di la oración corta. Luego dila otra vez agregando dónde y cuándo.

label: It sounds like a whole sentence
Suena como una oración completa

write.model: The yellow bus stops near our school every morning.

familyTalk.en: Walk around your block and grow a sentence about what you see: 'A truck stops ...'
familyTalk.es: Caminen por su cuadra y hagan crecer una oración sobre lo que ven: 'A truck stops ...'

teacherTip.en: Point to a town map. Children add a where detail by naming a place on the map.
teacherTip.es: Señala un mapa del pueblo. Los niños agregan un detalle de dónde nombrando un lugar en el mapa.

sets.title: Grow a Math Sentence
sets.titleEs: Haz crecer una oración de matemáticas

learn.rule: Add who, what, where, when, or why to grow a sentence.
learn.ruleEs: Agrega quién, qué, dónde, cuándo o por qué para hacer crecer la oración.
learn.model: 🔢 We count the blue blocks on the rug today.
learn.notice: Find the what, the where, and the when.

items.prompt: Which question does 'at the table' answer?
items.text: 🍪 Mia shares cookies at the table.
items.why: At the table tells where Mia shares cookies.
items.whyEs: At the table dice dónde reparte galletas Mia.

items.prompt: Which question does 'during math time' answer?
items.text: 📐 We measure the desk during math time.
items.why: During math time tells when we measure.
items.whyEs: During math time dice cuándo medimos.

items.prompt: Which question does 'to practice adding' answer?
items.text: 🎲 We roll dice to practice adding.
items.why: To practice adding tells why we roll dice.
items.whyEs: To practice adding dice por qué lanzamos dados.

items.model: 🔢 We count by twos during math.
items.why: During math tells when we count by twos.
items.whyEs: During math dice cuándo contamos de dos en dos.

items.prompt: Check every group of words that tells who.
items.why: My partner, the whole class, and Ms. Ortiz tell who.
items.whyEs: My partner, the whole class y Ms. Ortiz dicen quién.

items.prompt: Which blocks sentence has the most details?

options.text: We stack ten red blocks on the rug after lunch.

items.why: The last sentence tells what, where, and when.
items.whyEs: La última oración dice qué, dónde y cuándo.

write.prompt: Say the short sentence. Then say it again and add where and when.
write.promptEs: Di la oración corta. Luego dila otra vez agregando dónde y cuándo.

label: It sounds like a whole sentence
Suena como una oración completa

write.model: We measure our desks with rulers during math.

familyTalk.en: Count or measure something at home and grow a sentence: 'We count ...' (where? when?)
familyTalk.es: Cuenten o midan algo en casa y hagan crecer una oración: 'We count ...' (¿dónde? ¿cuándo?)

teacherTip.en: Use real manipulatives. Children say the short sentence, then add one detail each time you hold up a card.
teacherTip.es: Usa manipulativos reales. Los niños dicen la oración corta y agregan un detalle cada vez que muestras una tarjeta.
